City of Encinitas
Mobility and Traffic Commission Special Meeting
AGENDA
APRIL 21, 2025 -
05:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.

2.

3.

4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Oral comments (maximum of 3 minutes) will be heard from people who submit a WHITE speaker's slip to the Commission Secretary. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. No discussion or action may legally be taken on such non-agenda items. If at least two Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
